name: para-Camphorene

pubchem.title: alpha-Camphorene
pubchem.description: Alpha-camphorene is a cycloalkene that is cyclohexene substituted by 2-methylpent-2-en-5-yl and 6-methylhepta-1,5-dien-2-yl groups at positions 1 and 4, respectively. It is a diterpene isolated from several plant species. It has a role as a volatile oil component. It is a cycloalkene and a diterpene.

evidence: Measured in 1 of 6 MONDAYS hemp SKUs at 0.07% of total volatiles (0.014mg per chew).

consumer_summary.what_it_is: para-Camphorene is a large, volatile molecule known as a diterpene. As a component of plant essential oils, it contributes to the complex, earthy aromas of the botanicals that produce it.
consumer_summary.found_in: It has been identified in the mastic tree (Pistacia lentiscus), an evergreen shrub famous for producing an aromatic resin used in Mediterranean cuisine and traditional practices.
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: Because it is a diterpene, a class of molecules often prized for their biological activity, para-camphorene is of structural interest to natural-product chemists. However, it has not yet been the focus of dedicated pharmacological or clinical research, leaving its specific effects in the body largely unexplored. Currently, there is no formal evidence evaluating its potential health benefits.
consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: There are currently no published studies evaluating the health effects or biological activity of this molecule.
